subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this broad generated-media completion issue remain canonical while open follow-up PRs land, or should maintainers split the remaining mechanisms now?
rationale: Current main partially fixes the original report, but live GitHub state and source show remaining mechanisms with different owner boundaries.

options.title: Keep canonical open
options.body: Retain this issue as the parent tracker until the wake-false and cron/session follow-up PRs are resolved.

options.title: Split and close later
options.body: Create or confirm narrower canonical issues for each remaining mechanism, then close this parent only after those links preserve the context.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical open
recommendation.body: Retain this issue as the parent tracker until the wake-false and cron/session follow-up PRs are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from area history and the maintainer reopen comment that defined the parent issue's current scope.
